state_omissions.description: The accepted update sets summary and next_action but saves no evidence-backed state entry for the rename/caller changes. Possible handoff weakness; no handoff failure observed in this single-increment trial.

protocol_deviations: Persistent-path correction a0596a5 preserves seed bytes/original per-row mtimes and controls. Coordinator reports 11 scoped tool calls totaling about 32.5 seconds versus about 0.081 seconds child execution; accounts include permission review and transport, not isolated approval latency.

Initial packet evidence export had one extra trailing LF relative to the 1,890-byte immutable object. Reviewer detected it; coordinator corrected only the export and verified byte/hash equality. Original altered bytes are not preserved as raw history; the reviewer payload and written repair account retain the observation. Worker-format repairs remain 0.

An initial unscoped native inventory displayed a preexisting sibling completed status summary. Coordinator reports no sibling artifact/source use and later scoped inventories; exposure limits coordinator blinding, and its effect is unknown from available internal histories.

Reviewer independently checked behavior and gate binding but marked tree-hash derivation unknown. Root recomputed live project hash before/after exact evaluator gate and matched the passing checkpoint/review.
Full native internal tool histories and consistent three-role usage/cost are unavailable; raw durable goal/objects and terminal payloads are preserved separately from authored accounts.
